Synopsis:
    Israel killed senior Hamas military commander Mohammed Abdel Salam al-Yazouri in a Gaza airstrike, confirmed by Hamas' armed wing. Two other commanders were also killed. The strike occurs amid ongoing U.S.-backed ceasefire efforts that have so far failed to halt Israel's military campaign, now entering its third year since the October 7, 2023 attacks.
